widget.name: Layout Overlay
widget.description: Place clickable, draggable shape markers at X/Y coordinates over a background layout image. Shapes can be built-in, custom SVG paths or images. Every interaction can trigger a Mendix action.

property.caption: Markers
property.description: One object per marker.

property.caption: X
property.description: Horizontal position. Must be editable for drag/move to save.

property.caption: Integer coordinates
property.description: Round X/Y to whole numbers before saving. Required when X/Y are Integer attributes (use Pixels as the coordinate unit for fine placement). Turn off for Decimal attributes.

property.caption: Y
property.description: Vertical position (0 = top). Must be editable for drag/move to save.

property.caption: Shape
property.description: Built-in: truck (top view), circle, square, triangle, diamond, star, hexagon, pin, cross, check, warning, thumbs-up, thumbs-down. Custom: "svg:<path d>" (24x24 viewBox) or "url:<image url>". Empty = circle.

property.caption: Shape (expression)
property.description: Alternative to the Shape attribute: an expression returning a shape name per marker, e.g. if $currentObject/Occupied then 'truck' else 'circle'. Can use page variables. Used when the Shape attribute is empty or not set.

property.caption: Color
property.description: CSS color (e.g. "#2e7d32").

property.caption: Size (px)
property.description: Marker size in pixels, read from an attribute per marker. Order of precedence: this attribute, then Size (expression), then Default marker size.

property.caption: Size (expression, px)
property.description: Alternative to the Size attribute: an expression returning the size in px per marker, e.g. a page variable or if $currentObject/Priority = 1 then 40 else 28. Used when the Size attribute is empty or not set.

property.caption: Angle offset (deg)
property.description: Extra rotation in degrees (clockwise), added to Orientation. Use for fine angles such as 12.5.

property.caption: Label
property.description: Text shown beside the marker.

property.caption: Orientation
property.description: Direction the icon faces: an angle in degrees (0 = right/east, 90 = down/south, clockwise) or a name: N, NE, E, SE, S, SW, W, NW (also up, down, left, right).

property.caption: Mirror (flip horizontally)
property.description: Boolean (or "true"/"yes") to flip the icon left-right (mainly for custom side-view icons).

property.caption: Scale
property.description: Uniform size multiplier on top of Size / default size (1 = normal, 2 = double, 0.5 = half).

property.caption: Scale X (width)
property.description: Extra horizontal stretch multiplier (1 = none). Combined with Scale.

property.caption: Scale Y (height)
property.description: Extra vertical stretch multiplier (1 = none). Combined with Scale.

property.caption: Occupancy
property.description: Boolean (or text). Occupied (true / "occupied" / "yes" / "busy") draws the shape with a solid line in its color; not occupied (false / "available" / "empty" / "no" / "free") draws it with a dotted line. When set, it takes precedence over Fill. Empty or unknown values fall back to Fill.

property.caption: Fill (filled / empty)
property.description: Filled or empty (outline) icon. Boolean true, or text occupied / filled / yes / busy = filled; false, or available / empty / outline / no / free = outline. Works for every shape, e.g. a filled truck for an occupied bay and an outlined truck for an empty one.

property.caption: Pulse (alert)
property.description: Boolean attribute. When true the marker gets an animated pulsing ring, e.g. for safety alerts or overstay.

property.caption: Tooltip
property.description: Text shown in the browser tooltip when hovering the marker.

property.caption: Background image
property.description: Layout / floor plan image. Use a static image, or a Dynamic image taken from an Image object in the page context, e.g. the PSL object (PSL is an Image entity), so each PSL shows its own layout.

property.caption: Background URL
property.description: Dynamic image URL. Overrides the static image when it returns a value.

property.caption: Coordinate unit
property.description: Percent: X and Y are 0-100 of canvas. Pixels: X and Y are in canvas width/height units.

property.caption: Canvas size from image
property.description: On: the canvas takes the layout image's own pixel size, so the image is never stretched and, in Pixels mode, X/Y are in the image's own pixels. Always on when Layouts are configured (each layout keeps its own picture proportions). Otherwise: off = Canvas width / height below are used.

property.caption: Canvas width
property.description: Reference width; sets aspect ratio, and the X range in pixel mode. The canvas scales to its container.

property.caption: Canvas height
property.description: Reference height; sets aspect ratio, and the Y range in pixel mode.

property.caption: Default marker size (px)
property.description: Marker size in pixels when no Size attribute value is available.

property.caption: Default shape
property.description: Shape used for markers that have no value in the Shape attribute or Shape expression. Pick the shape directly here when all markers look the same. For a custom vector or image use the Shape attribute ("svg:..." / "url:...").

property.caption: Default fill
property.description: Used when no Fill or Occupancy value is available.

property.caption: Occupied style
property.description: How an occupied marker is drawn when Occupancy is set: a solid line (outline) or a solid filled shape. Not occupied is always a dotted line.

property.caption: Default marker color
property.description: CSS color used when no Color attribute value is available.

property.caption: Allow zoom and scroll
property.description: Ctrl + mouse wheel zooms in and out around the cursor. Scroll and Shift + scroll pan; dragging empty space pans when not editing. Adds zoom buttons.

property.caption: Mouse wheel zoom
property.description: Ctrl + wheel: hold Ctrl (or Cmd) and scroll to zoom; plain scroll scrolls the page. Wheel: the wheel alone zooms around the cursor (hold Shift to scroll sideways). Middle mouse button, or dragging empty space when not editing, pans.

property.caption: Minimum zoom (%)
property.description: 100 = canvas fits the widget width.

property.caption: Maximum zoom (%)
property.description: Upper zoom limit.

property.caption: Initial zoom (%)
property.description: Zoom level when the widget loads. Use e.g. 300 for a very wide plan.

property.caption: Marker scaling
property.description: How icons and labels follow zoom. Proportional (default) scales exactly with the plan, like the drawing itself; Smooth grows with the square root of the zoom; Fixed keeps pixel size. Labels scale with the icons (within a readable range).

property.caption: Max viewport height (px)
property.description: Caps the widget height; content scrolls vertically inside it when zoomed. 0 = 80% of the window height.

property.caption: Show labels from zoom (%)
property.description: Hide marker labels below this zoom level to declutter dense plans. 0 = always show.

property.caption: Label orientation
property.description: Turns with the truck: for trucks the label sits on the truck's axis at its rear or cabin end (see Truck label side), never beside it, and turns with it so it stays readable; other shapes keep the label below. Upright: the label stays horizontal below the icon.

enumerationValues.enumerationValue: Turns with the truck (at its rear or cabin end)

property.caption: Label font
property.description: Optional CSS font family for labels and the title, e.g. Segoe UI, Arial or Verdana. Empty = a clean system font (Segoe UI on Windows). Only fonts installed on the user's computer or already loaded by your theme can be used.

property.caption: Label corner radius (px)
property.description: Corner rounding of the label bubble. 0 = square corners, 3 = slightly rounded (default), larger = more rounded; a very large value gives a pill.

property.caption: Label font size (px)
property.description: Base label text size in px at 100% zoom; it scales with zoom and no longer depends on how thin the icon is. Raise it if labels are hard to read.

property.caption: Truck label text
property.description: Along the truck: the text turns with the truck (compact, good for tightly packed bays). Horizontal: the text is always horizontal (easiest to read) and the bubble touches the truck's end; it can be wider than the truck.

property.caption: Truck label side
property.description: Which end of the truck the label sits at, on the truck's axis: behind the rear (default) or in front of the cabin. Applies when Label orientation is "Turns with the truck".

property.caption: Truck label width
property.description: Same width as the truck: the label bubble is exactly as thick as the truck body and the text shrinks to fit inside it (make the truck thicker with Size or Scale Y for larger text). Readable: the bubble is as thick as the truck but never thinner than the text needs. Fit to text: the bubble is only as big as its text.

enumerationValues.enumerationValue: Truck's width, at least text height

property.caption: Outline tint (%)
property.description: How strongly the inside of empty / not-occupied icons is tinted with their color (a pale fill that keeps them visible over a busy drawing). 0 = see-through.

property.caption: Outline thickness (px)
property.description: Line thickness of outline (empty / not occupied) icons, in screen pixels. Dotted lines use dots of this width, so raise it if they are hard to see.

property.caption: Show grid
property.description: Draw a background grid to help positioning.

property.caption: Snap to grid
property.description: Snap step in coordinate units while dragging. 0 = off.

property.caption: Allow editing
property.description: Show an Edit toggle. In edit mode markers can be dragged, nudged with arrow keys, and the selected marker's shape/color/size/position can be changed (when attributes are editable).

property.caption: Edit allowed (expression)
property.description: Optional. A Boolean expression deciding who sees the Edit button, e.g. an attribute of the page context that is true for administrators. Empty = everyone sees Edit (while Allow editing is on). The button stays hidden while the expression is loading or false. This only hides the UI; also check the role in the "On marker moved / changed" microflow, because the browser is not a security boundary.

property.caption: Start in edit mode
property.description: Open the widget with editing already switched on.

property.caption: Fire click events while editing
property.description: Off (default): marker click, double click and right click actions run only when Edit is off; while editing, a click just selects the marker. On: they also run while editing.

property.caption: Clicked X (output)
property.description: Receives the X of an empty-canvas click before "On canvas click" fires.

property.caption: Clicked Y (output)
property.description: Receives the Y of an empty-canvas click before "On canvas click" fires.

property.caption: Moved X (output)
property.description: Fallback when the marker's own X/Y are read-only: receives the new X after a drag. Read it in the "On marker moved / changed" action (a context object, e.g. the page data view).

property.caption: Moved Y (output)
property.description: Fallback when the marker's own X/Y are read-only: receives the new Y after a drag.

property.caption: Layouts (e.g. PSL)
property.description: One object per layout, e.g. the PSL records (one per shop). The drop-down then lists these layouts, with no "All" choice; the selected layout decides the background picture, the title and which markers are shown.

property.caption: Layout name (e.g. Shop)
property.description: Text shown in the drop-down for each layout, e.g. the PSL's Shop. Markers whose Group attribute (Filter tab) equals this value belong to that layout.

property.caption: Drop-down text (expression)
property.description: Optional text shown in the drop-down for each layout, e.g. $currentObject/Location + ' | ' + $currentObject/Plant. When empty, Layout name is used.

property.caption: Layout title (expression)
property.description: Title shown for the selected layout, e.g. 'Truck Bay Status : ' + $currentObject/Location + ' | ' + $currentObject/Plant. Overrides the Title settings.

property.caption: Marker -> layout association (e.g. Bay_PSL)
property.description: The association from a marker (Bay) to its layout (PSL). The selected layout then shows exactly the markers linked to it, whatever their text values are. When empty, markers are matched by comparing the Group attribute (Filter tab) with Layout name.

property.caption: Layout picture
property.description: Drop an Image widget here and point it at the layout's own picture (the PSL image, dynamic image). Only the selected layout's picture is drawn, as the plan background. Set the Image widget's width and height to 100%.

property.caption: Group attribute (e.g. Shop)
property.description: When set, a drop-down appears in the toolbar listing every distinct value of this attribute (plus "All groups"), and selecting one shows only that group's markers.

property.caption: Extra search attribute
property.description: Optional additional attribute the search box looks in. The search always matches the marker's Label and the Group attribute.

property.caption: Offer "All" option
property.description: Off: the drop-down has no "All" choice and the first group is selected at start, so exactly one group is always shown. (With Layouts configured there is never an "All" option.)

property.caption: Show search box
property.description: A box in the toolbar: type to show only markers whose label, group (e.g. shop) or extra search attribute contains the text.

property.caption: Search placeholder
property.description: Hint text shown in the empty search box.

property.caption: "All" option text
property.description: Text of the first drop-down option that clears the group filter.

property.caption: Non-matching markers
property.description: Hide: markers that do not match are removed from the plan. Dim: they stay but are faded and not clickable, so you keep the context.

property.caption: On marker click
property.description: Action executed when a marker is clicked. Runs in the context of that marker object.

property.caption: On marker double click
property.description: Action executed when a marker is double clicked.

property.caption: On marker right click
property.description: Action executed when a marker is right clicked (browser menu is suppressed).

property.caption: On marker moved / changed
property.description: Fires after X/Y (or other attributes) were written. Commit the object here if needed.

property.caption: On canvas click
property.description: Fires on an empty-canvas click in edit mode, after Clicked X/Y are set. Use to create a new marker.

property.caption: Title
property.description: Bold first line of the hover card, e.g. the bay name. Can use marker attributes as parameters.

property.caption: Lines
property.description: One entry per line in the hover card. Each line is a text template evaluated for the hovered marker, e.g. "Avg: {1} min Util: {2}%". Lines that evaluate to empty text are hidden.

property.caption: Text
property.description: Line text; use {1}, {2}... for marker attributes.

property.caption: Bold
property.description: Render this line in bold.

property.caption: Hover delay (ms)
property.description: Delay before the card appears.

property.caption: Title (plain text)
property.description: The simplest way: type the heading here, e.g. TRUCK CALLING SYSTEM - AS-KB. Shown above the plan in the toolbar. Used when Title (expression) and Title (text template) give no text.

property.caption: Title (expression)
property.description: Dynamic heading from an expression, e.g. 'TRUCK CALLING SYSTEM - ' + $Area/Name. Not language dependent. Used before Title (plain text).

property.caption: Title (text template)
property.description: Heading as a translatable text template. Note: templates are stored per language, so the text only shows for the language it was typed in. Prefer Title (plain text) or Title (expression) if the title does not appear.

property.caption: Title size (px)
property.description: Font size of the title.

property.caption: Title alignment
property.description: Where the title sits in the toolbar: left (before the buttons), center (between the buttons and the legend) or right (after the legend).

property.caption: Legend items
property.description: Legend shown above the canvas: up to 6 entries, each with its own shape, color and caption (e.g. "Planned and Occupied" in green).

property.caption: Caption
property.description: Legend text.

property.caption: Color
property.description: CSS color of the swatch.

property.caption: Filled
property.description: Show the legend swatch filled (on) or as an empty outline (off).

property.caption: Dotted
property.description: Draw the swatch outline dotted (only when Filled is off), e.g. for "Not occupied".

property.caption: Shape
property.description: Same names as the marker Shape attribute (circle, square, triangle, ...).
